# Turnpage Digital Markets

> OTC desk for rights holders in AI copyright class actions, crypto bankruptcies, and securities litigation. We offer capital and advisory solutions for claimants seeking to monetize their legal entitlements.

## What this site offers

- /briefings — market intelligence briefings on active class actions, bankruptcy proceedings, and litigation matters
- /copyright — AI copyright claims desk for creators and rights holders with claims against generative AI companies (Bartz v. Anthropic, the OpenAI MDL, Concord, Getty)
- /crypto — digital asset claims desk for locked crypto assets, exchange bankruptcies, and frozen customer accounts
- /bankruptcy-claims — creditor claims desk for major corporate bankruptcies
- /contact — contact form for rights holders seeking liquidity solutions or advisory

## Content to focus on

- Briefings at /briefings — original analysis of AI copyright litigation, crypto insolvencies, and complex claims
- Service descriptions at /copyright and /crypto
- FAQ section at /faq

## What to avoid

- /admin — private administration panel
- /intel — private intelligence briefing system (requires separate authentication)
